result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and traffic signals, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide multi-lane roadway lacks a refuge island, and mature trees near the corners may create sightline challenges between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vegetation
hazards.description: Large, low-hanging trees near the intersection corners may partially obscure pedestrians from the view of turning motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages, reducing exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers by moving them further into the line of sight.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light, making them more visible to turning traffic.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a curb ramp with tactile paving. However, large utility boxes on the sidewalk corner create a significant visual obstruction between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Utility Boxes
hazards.description: Large grey utility boxes are positioned right at the corner, blocking the line of sight between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground on the sidewalk corner.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires a long unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extension (Bulbout)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position beyond the utility boxes.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Relocate the utility boxes away from the immediate corner to clear sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with sidewalks and curb ramps, but lacks marked crosswalks and visible pedestrian signals. Safety is compromised by dense vegetation blocking sightlines and trash bins obstructing the sidewalk path.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Trash bins are placed directly in the pedestrian path on the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense trees and bushes block the view of the intersection for both pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalk is visible at this signalized intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove vegetation near the corner to improve sightlines between road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides of the street. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of a median refuge increase exposure for pedestrians crossing multiple lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median refuge island.

hazards.name: Vehicle Encroachment
hazards.description: Vehicles are positioned very close to the crosswalk markings, which can reduce visibility and reaction time.
